originalTitle: GTA VI keeps leaking ahead of its gameplay premiere
summary: Clips of what appears to be Grand Theft Auto VI have hit the internet, possibly spoiling aspects of the game ahead of Rockstar Games' deep dive debuting on Netflix next week and its long-awaited launch in November. content: Clips of what appears to be Grand Theft Auto VI have hit the internet, possibly spoiling aspects of the game ahead of Rockstar Games’ deep dive debuting on Netflix next week and its long-awaited launch in November. I’ve seen three clips seemingly showing off the game, though two have been pulled from the site I saw them on “due to a copyright claim.” The first clip (now removed) was a quiet scene that mostly focused on Jason Duval, one the game’s two protagonists, shooting a basketball into a hoop. Another clip (also removed) featured more of the crime-focused gameplay you’d expect from GTA, including Duval hitting a person with a wrench, and also showed the return of a six-star Wanted system. A third clip, which is live as I write this, shows Duval driving at night, punching some people, using a taser, and stealing a truck. The clip then jumps to what looks like a cutscene from a different part of the game in the daytime. The videos were watermarked by a person or group identifying themselves as “CyberLeek.” The third clip has a call for viewers to buy a CyberLeek cryptocurrency, a QR code, links to some sketchy-looking CyberLeek URLs, and a statement that says “NO PHYSICAL DISCS? THEN MORE LEEKS!”, which is seemingly a reference to Rockstar’s decision not to launch GTA VI on a physical disc. This isn’t the first time apparent footage from GTA VI has leaked. In 2022, 90 videos leaked online long before the game’s official reveal more than a year later (a reveal that also leaked, leading Rockstar to publish the game’s first trailer a day early). A teen who played a key role in leaking the 90 videos was sentenced to life in a secure hospital. Rockstar also confirmed earlier this year that it had data compromised in a hack of a third-party provider, but said the incident would have “no impact on our organization or our players.” Rockstar and owner Take-Two didn’t immediately reply to a request for comment. The GTA VI “extended look” premieres on Netflix on August 27th at 3PM ET and will stream on YouTube at 9PM ET. The $79.99 title is scheduled to launch on November 19th, and for the most part, the industry is steering clear of November and launching their big games earlier in the year.
chineseTitle: GTA VI 在游戏首映前不断泄露
chineseSummary: 疑似《侠盗猎车手 6》的视频片段已经在互联网上流传，这可能会在 Rockstar Games 下周在 Netflix 上深度亮相以及期待已久的 11 月发布之前破坏游戏的某些方面。我看过三个看似展示游戏的剪辑，尽管其中两个是从我的网站上撤下的 [...]
chineseContent: 疑似《侠盗猎车手 6》的视频片段已经在互联网上流传，这可能会在 Rockstar Games 下周在 Netflix 上首次亮相以及期待已久的 11 月发布之前破坏游戏的某些方面。我看过三个看似展示游戏的剪辑，尽管“由于版权声明”，我从我看到它们的网站上删除了两个剪辑。第一个片段（现已删除）是一个安静的场景，主要聚焦于杰森·杜瓦尔（游戏的两个主角之一）将篮球投进篮筐。另一个片段（也被删除）展示了更多你所期望的 GTA 中以犯罪为中心的游戏玩法，包括杜瓦尔用扳手打人，并且还展示了六星通缉系统的回归。第三段视频在我写这篇文章时正在直播，显示杜瓦尔在夜间开车，殴打一些人，使用泰瑟枪，并偷了一辆卡车。然后，该剪辑跳转到白天游戏不同部分的过场动画。这些视频被自称为“Cyber​​Leek”的个人或团体加了水印。第三段视频呼吁观众购买 Cyber​​Leek 加密货币、二维码、一些看起来粗略的 Cyber​​Leek URL 链接，以及一份声明，上面写着“没有实体光盘？那就更多韭菜！”，这似乎是在暗示 Rockstar 决定不在实体光盘上推出 GTA VI。这并不是 GTA VI 的明显镜头第一次被泄露。 2022 年，早在一年多后游戏正式发布之前，就有 90 个视频在网上泄露（这一泄露也导致 Rockstar 提前一天发布了游戏的第一个预告片）。一名在泄露 90 段视频的过程中发挥关键作用的青少年被判处终身监禁，并被送往一家安全的医院。 Rockstar 今年早些时候还证实，其数据在第三方提供商的黑客攻击中遭到泄露，但表示该事件
